'''Kodam''' was a young male [[Aes Sedai (Age of Legends)|Aes Sedai]] during the [[Breaking of the World]].

== Activities ==
His name is mentioned in the Seventh vision of Rand in the [[Glass columns|ter'angreal of Rhuidean]] when [[Oselle]] Sedai asks [[Solinda]] Sedai whether they can trust Kodam and his fellows, and Solinda replies ''"We must, Oselle. They are young and inexperienced, but barely touched by the taint, and... And we have no choice."''{{ref/book|4|26}}

== Making the Eye of the World ==
Kodam and his fellows most probably died at the [[Eye of the World]]. His death particularly is not known, only that those who made the Eye died during the process. Jonai's memories indicate that [[Callandor]] was taken care of later, after the [[Dragon Banner]]. ''"The sword must wait."'' as it is said, and Callandor was set in the [[Stone of Tear]] also with the use of both saidin and saidar. The order of the events are not known, neither of which male Aes Sedai helped at what location.
